workout_name: Emigration Canyon Extended Sweet Spot Intervals
reasoning: This workout addresses your limiter of poor lactate clearance and low fatigue resistance. By combining extended sweet spot intervals with back-to-back fatigue-resistance work, we directly challenge your ability to maintain higher power outputs over time. Considering your last ride's average power was quite low, this structured session will better prepare you for the Alpine Loop’s sustained climbs.

suggested_sets.name: Main Set
suggested_sets.description: 3x [12 minutes at 218W (94%), 3 minutes at 245W (103%)], focus on staying controlled

weekly_focus: This week: progressive loading — keep attacking the lactate clearance gap.
